en.headline: Police arrest man after dog found hanging from tree on Tai Po trail
en.dek: A 54-year-old man was arrested on Sunday evening on suspicion of cruelty to animals after his sister reported finding a dog hanging lifeless from a tree outside their stone hut on the Wilson Trail.
body: Police said a 57-year-old woman called them around midday on Sunday after discovering a white mongrel hanging from a tree outside a stone hut on section eight of the Wilson Trail in Tai Po, near Ma Wo Road.

The dog, which the arrested man's sister said he had taken in as a stray about a year earlier and fed regularly, was confirmed dead at the scene. Officers later arrested the 54-year-old man on suspicion of cruelty to animals.
The case has been classified as cruelty to animals and is being investigated by the Tai Po District Crime Squad. The Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals collected the dog's body.

zh.headline: 大埔衞奕信徑唐狗被吊樹上死亡 警方拘捕54歲男子涉虐畜
zh.dek: 一名57歲女子周日中午報案，指胞弟飼養的唐狗被吊在石屋外樹上氣絕，警方晚上以涉嫌殘酷對待動物拘捕54歲胞弟。
body: 警方表示，周日中午約12時半，一名住在大埔衞奕信徑第8段石屋的57歲女子報案，發現她胞弟飼養的白色唐狗被人吊在屋外樹上，明顯死亡。
據了解，該狗隻原為流浪狗，約一年前由被捕男子拾獲並帶回石屋飼養。報案人發現時，胞弟及其友人在附近，懷疑與事件有關。
警方經調查後拘捕54歲男子，案件列作殘酷對待動物，交由大埔警區刑事調查隊跟進。狗隻屍體已由愛護動物協會人員檢走。
